title: Gentle Arch Work
summary: The broad thumb pad glides along the soft tissues of the arch.
startingPosition: The foot is supported with the sole facing the practitioner.
instructions: Place the thumb pad on the arch.
direction: Along the soft tissues of the arch.
warning: Do not massage with recent injury, marked swelling, ulcers, infection, severe pain, or impaired sensation unless medically advised.
imageAlt: Educational diagram: gentle arch work, without text labels.
